response.query: What MVPA/RSA cross‑validation and permutation schemes (e.g., leave‑one‑subject/site‑out) will best support cross‑domain generalization and control for overfitting?
response.answer: For MVPA/RSA, leave-one-subject/site-out cross-validation and permutation testing are best for cross-domain generalization and overfitting control. Repeated 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-out methods also help ensure robust performance.
